product_metadata.title: Aquazolax Thin Sheer French Door Curtain Panel Elegant Solid Voile Curtain 54x40 Inches Glass Door Drapery and Drape with Tieback - 1 Panel, Grey
features: READY MADE: Package includes 1 panel of 54" wide x 40" length Sheer Door Curtain (137cm x 101cm), WITH A BONUS ADJUSTABLE VELCRO TIEBACK. Size measurements are from the top of the curtain to the bottom, including the rod pockets. Perfect for your French style front door, patio doors with glass or any other window space that fit.

MATERIAL & TOP DESIGN: THIN SHEER Fabric, TRANSPARENT Voile, Lightweight, super Soft. They can blow in the wind, giving you a sense of airy. ROD POCKET design makes them easy to slide through your curtain rod. 2 Rod Pockets on each end (you can adjust your hanging with them) gives the curtain a nice fit to your rod.

HOME DECORATION: These beautifully crafted Sheer Door Curtains allow plenty of natural light to filter into your house, yet will transform your decor at the same time. This fashionable sheer combined with the rich warm look will complete the room setting in any home, dressing your window with the elegance and romance you want.

FUNCTIONAL: These voile sheer door drapes enable you to appreciate the beautiful scene outside the door freely while sustaining a little privacy if properly pleated. PLEASE BE NOTED that the transparent sheer curtain width should be at least 1.5-2 times width of your door window for enough pleat so that it can achieve a bit of obscure effect.
EASY CARE: Made to last with 100% durable polyester. Machine wash cold on gentle cycle. Tumble dry low. No bleach. Cool iron when needed.
